description: This repository pins upstream images by tag and digest in plain manifests, and an installation runs those pins as they are (ADR-0055). It pins every action and reusable workflow by digest with its release tag. It holds the application sources and the devcontainer that an installation must carry byte for byte (ADR-0054), so their npm, Maven and devcontainer tool updates land here and reach an installation when it moves its pin. Renovate keeps all of these current. Only the kubernetes, github-actions, npm, maven and pip_requirements managers and the regex managers below are enabled: other dependencies are out of this configuration's scope.

pip_requirements.description: The TechDocs generator's one Python requirement in the Backstage image.

kubernetes.description: The plain manifests that pin an upstream image by tag and digest.

customManagers.description: The publish-check job checks out estate-baseline by digest. The github-actions manager does not read a checkout's ref, so this manager moves it with the estate-baseline uses: pins.
Detect ArgoCD CLI version in Dockerfile

packageRules.description: The gate checkout and the estate-baseline actions and workflows move together: the publish-check job runs the checkout's gate with the action's scanners.
The npm and maven managers update only the applications an installation carries byte for byte; the next rule enables those. The baseline preset groups their updates weekly.
The applications an installation carries byte for byte, and the parent POM the Java applications inherit their versions from.

No automerge for npm or Maven updates, which overrides the baseline preset's devDependency and test-dependency automerge. The application builds and tests (node-apps, java-apps, maven) are not required status checks here, so GitHub's auto-merge would merge a bump that fails them.
